sources.label: Morphe Patches
sources.author: JoFSlash
patch_list: Block tracking

Stops the analytics and marketing trackers: Firebase and Google Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics and Sessions, Facebook app events, and Kochava install and purchase tracking. Signing in, syncing your diary and Premium purchases keep working.
Disable in-app messages
Stops the pop-ups and banners that Kalorické Tabulky sends to the app as marketing campaigns (Firebase In-App Messaging). Push notifications and the app's own messages stay.
GmsCore support

Makes signing in with Google and push notifications work through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't sign in with Google through Play services, because it is no longer signed by its maker. Needs MicroG-RE install…
Hide ads
Hides the ad banners and the full-screen ads, and never starts the ad networks (Google AdMob and AppLovin) or asks for ad consent. Premium and your subscription aren't touched.
Hide device pairing pop-up

Hides the screen that opens by itself two days after you install the app and asks you to connect a watch, a fitness tracker or another app, when you have none connected yet. You can still connect them in the settings.
Hide home banner
Hides the picture banner on the home screen that Kalorické Tabulky fills from its servers, for example with offers and news.
Hide Premium buttons
Hides the Premium button in the home screen's top bar and the "Get Premium benefits" button in the add menu (the + button). The Premium offers you open from a Premium feature stay.
Hide Premium offers

Hides the Premium offers that show up by themselves: the trial banners on the home, search and profile screens, the Premium offer after you sign in and the full-screen Premium offer after an ad. Premium itself, its features and the offers…
Hide rating prompts
Hides the card on the home screen that asks how you like the app and then asks you to rate it on Google Play.
Remove location access
Removes the location permission. Food court (restaurant meals near you) and the partner benefits near you then can't use your location.
Remove unneeded permissions

Removes the permissions that only serve advertising and install tracking: the advertising ID, Android's ad services (ad ID, attribution, topics and custom audiences), the Google Play install referrer and the Google Play license check.
